title: Retaliation Run, a Return Fire Inspired top view war game
author: CoolTIOnline
selftext:
Hey guys, I would like to share my solo-developed game here.

It's called Retaliation Run (a Return Fire inspired game made in Godot).

I am a 43 year old guy who's works in I.T. Infrastructure, admin, hosting, voip, support and some dev work for over 20 years... I loved videogames since the NES and started PC Gaming on my friend's 486 with Death Rally, Warcraft, Warcraft2, Rott, doom, Dune2, C&C...)

I always dreamed of making a videogame but coding has never been my thing. I simply suck at languages and 8 years married to a Brazilian, I still can't speak Portuguese.  
Back when I was 17 I went into computer science and I just hated C++. I later went into I.T. Networking, worked and grew in the field ever since.

With that being said,

I am no coding expert so my game wouldn't exist if Claude wasn't here to help me realize my vision.  
The music is a mix of licensed classical tracks such as The Hall Of Mountain King, Flight Of The Valkyries, and some others generated with Suno.  
I have also used Tripo to generate 3D models to then fix and correct them using Blender.

  
For my videogame, when it came to building 3D models I was told to try the new ChatGPT Astra and holy crap does it suck. Took days to work with it and learning Blender to make something painfully mediocre. Later I fell on a youtube video that showed me how to make a house and the crumbling animation that looked far better and more efficiently then what ChatGPT was suggesting. I tried it and was able to make something decent... Not perfect but I learned a lot.  
That's when I tried Tripo, I generated houses and with what I learned in blender, I asked Claude to write me a script to automate the process and apply it on the models which worked out great.  
  
To my experience most AI are trolls. But in the end it's about figuring out their weaknesses and adapting... But some are far better than others.  
In my opinion, Claude is the goat.   
ChatGPT is ok for basic search questions here or there but while capable at coding, he isn't great.   
Meta AI is decent to generate pictures but the second you ask him for corrections, he will troll by doing 1 correction and breaking something else.   
Once on a Microsoft Power Apps project I tried Microsoft Copilot and holy crap he is the absolute worst. He can't give a working line of code in Microsoft's own software...  
I have never tried Grok.

Regardless of the use of AI, I have been working hard on this for some time and happy to say I learned so much about coding, game design and blender.  
I can't wait to get it released in the near future. I always have a ton of fun play testing it and recently even more fun testing the multiplayer.

Making a videogame has always been a dream of mine. Besides that, I have been working on this obsessively for some time now, constantly improving and adding features.  
Testing, fixing, testing on slower computers, optimizing and I feel like there is always more I can do.  
I hope people will have a lot of fun with it.

What's in it right now:  
\-Online or LAN multiplayer up to 8 players, teams from 1v1 to 4v4, FFA or Team FFA with voice chat radio channel system concept.  
\-Up to 4 players local split screen  
\-Two game modes: Capture the Flag or Destroy the enemy base.  
\-Tanks, APC, Rocket Tank, Jeeps and Helicopters, each with their own handling and sounds.  
\-AI players that fill empty seats, plus soldiers, smaller tanks, attack helicopters and defense towers that can be assigned as player assets for defense or environment which attacks everyone.  
\-Minimap with fog of war  
\-Arcade car handling for FWD, RWD and AWD cars. Added the handbreak of course because who doesn't like to do handbrake turns.  
\-If someone is knocked out in a team multiplayer game, he can grab one of the city cars and joyride around the map lobbing grenades at other players. (Though you are a fun and easy target)  
\- Built-in map editor  
\-In-game manual

I am always open for any feedback on the game, questions or suggestions.

Built with Godot. More info and the dev logs: [www.retaliationrun.com](http://www.retaliationrun.com)  
More gameplay videos: [https://www.youtube.com/@RetaliationRun](https://www.youtube.com/@RetaliationRun)
